summary: Evergy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting termination of a $500 million term loan credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., incurring no penalties, and issuance of $600 million 6.40% Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057. The notes were sold under an existing Form S-3 registration statement via an underwriting agreement with BofA Securities and others. This is routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. No strategic event, deal, or extraordinary action is indicated.
